scripts.deploy:public: npm run build:public && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.public.jsonc
scripts.test: npm run test:logic && npm run build && node --test tests/rendered-html.test.mjs
scripts.test:logic: node --test tests/pomodoro.test.mjs tests/retention.test.mjs tests/adventure-archive.test.mjs tests/seasonal-events.test.mjs tests/operations.test.mjs tests/local-study-coach.test.mjs tests/silent-camp.test.mjs tests/study-quests.test.mjs tests/push-reminders.test.mjs tests/pwa.test.mjs tests/cloud-state.test.mjs tests/public-auth.test.mjs tests/privacy.test.mjs tests/operating-policy.test.mjs tests/release-readiness.test.mjs tests/virtual-user-qa.test.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:staging: node --env-file-if-exists=.env.staging.local scripts/verify-staging-env.mjs && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.staging.local scripts/build-e2e.mjs --staging && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.staging.local node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test --config playwright.staging.config.ts
scripts.release:check: npm run lint && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run test:logic && npm run build && npm run release:budget && node --test tests/rendered-html.test.mjs && npm run security:secrets
scripts.lint: eslint app lib tests scripts worker db examples vite.config.ts next.config.ts drizzle.config.ts
